extDescription.message: Blocks YouTube Shorts, Mixes, and channels you choose. Tracks your watch time by category. Distraction-free, private, and free.

whatToBlockSub.message: Shorts (player, shelves, search, links), Mixes, end-of-video suggestions, "Explore more topics," continue-watching cards, autoplay, and Calm Mode's engagement-hook cleanup.

shelvesSub.message: The carousels on Home and Subscriptions

searchShortsSub.message: Results and shelves on the search page

looseShortsSub.message: In feeds, History, channels and up-next

shortsLinksSub.message: Sidebar entry, filter chip, channel tab

mixesSub.message: Auto-generated "Mixes for you" shelves and cards

endscreenSub.message: Removes the suggestion grid and corner teaser card the player shows near/after a video ends

exploreTopicsSub.message: The chip shelf suggesting other topics to browse, on Home and Subscriptions

continueWatchingSub.message: Video cards showing a "resume where you left off" progress bar, outside History

autoplaySub.message: Turns off and removes the autoplay toggle on watch pages

calmModeSub.message: Mutes red accents (including the YouTube logo) to slate blue, hides the notification unread count, softly blurs and warps thumbnails (hover to see clearly), disables thumbnail hover-preview

keywordsSub.message: Hides any video whose title, channel, or description matches.

matchWholeWordSub.message: Off: "war" also matches "software". On: exact word only.

suggestedRageBaitWords.message: exposed, slams, destroys, obliterates, meltdown, outrage, backlash, controversy

suggestedClickbaitWords.message: you won't believe, shocking, gone wrong, clickbait, must watch, game changer

channelsSub.message: Hides every video from a channel, everywhere — more reliable than YouTube's own "Don't recommend."

channelsDetail.message: Covers Home, Search, Subscriptions, and up-next. YouTube's own "Don't recommend this channel" is only a soft hint to the algorithm — it doesn't touch Search, and can fade over time. This is unconditional.

autoBlockSub.message: Once you've watched 60% of a video, its channel is added above automatically — and its name is blocked everywhere else too, in case a different channel features the same person. Both clear at midnight.

blockedNamesIntro.message: Also blocking any video that mentions these names today, on any channel:

categorySub.message: By YouTube's own category for each video. Tracked locally on this device only — never sent anywhere.

timeSpentSub.message: All-time, plus this and the last two months, weeks, and days.

recencySub.message: Whether you're mostly watching recent uploads or older videos.

lastWatchedEmpty.message: Open a video on YouTube to start tracking.

rateUs.message: Rate us & help Focus Tube reach more people

disclaimer.message: Unofficial · not affiliated with YouTube or Google
